name: codexscientist-codex
description: CodexScientist Codex plugin with stable curated MCP for repeated research-control workflows and CLI fallback for debugging, CI, migration, and recovery. Codex-native tools still handle routine file, shell, Git, test, build, and process work.

interface.shortDescription: Use stable curated MCP for CodexScientist research state, with scripts/csctl.py CLI fallback.
interface.longDescription: A self-contained Codex CLI plugin exposing project-local research state through scripts/cs_mcp.py as the stable curated MCP control plane and scripts/csctl.py as CLI fallback. Ordinary file editing/search, shell, Git, tests, builds, and process management remain Codex-native responsibilities.
defaultPrompt: Use CodexScientist Codex MCP only for CodexScientist research semantics: quest state, durable user requirements, memory, artifacts, baselines, experiment records, paper/reliability workflows, analysis campaign state, and formal evidence provenance. Use Codex-native file/search/edit/shell/Git/test/build/process capabilities for routine operation-layer work. Treat cs_bash_exec as a provenance tool for formal experiment, baseline, analysis, or paper-facing commands, not as a general shell replacement. Load the codexscientist-codex skill first, then load bundled support skills only when the subtask needs them. Keep the native Codex transport boundary and do not reintroduce protocol-server transport.
